system_overview: invoice-late-chaser is a automated overdue invoice chasing with escalating tone. It is built as a small focused system with Invoice Importer (CSV/API) at its core, supported by Tone Escalator and Send Window Scheduler.

recommended_language.rationale: Python fits the automated overdue invoice chasing with escalating tone workload on technical grounds.

quality_goals.goal: Correct output under normal failure modes

architecture_decisions.title: Use Invoice Importer (CSV/API) as the system core
architecture_decisions.rationale: The automated overdue invoice chasing with escalating tone hinges on this component working well.

positive: Single place to harden the critical path
negative: Core component becomes a bottleneck for change

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Operational overhead for a small system.

architecture_decisions.title: Run Send Window Scheduler asynchronously
architecture_decisions.chosen_option: Background processing for Send Window Scheduler
architecture_decisions.rationale: Keeps the interactive path fast on modest hardware.

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Ties user latency to slow external work.

what_not_to_build: A plugin system before there are users

risk_flags.risk: External dependency outage stalls the async path
risk_flags.mitigation: Retry with backoff and a dead-letter table.

open_questions: What is the realistic peak concurrent usage?
constraints: Entities Invoice, Chase, Customer must persist relationally
Components: Invoice Importer (CSV/API), Tone Escalator, Send Window Scheduler
